replaces.idea: An upright cylindrical steel dispatch canister with a riveted dark-blue header collar and a hinged brass clasp.
A small bakelite terminal block with two brass binding posts bridged by an arched copper jumper bar.
A tabletop brass tape-splicing press with a dark tape strip threaded under a hinged yellow-handled crimping lever.
A wall-mounted dark iron key-rack with four rows of brass hooks and one bright yellow key hanging on the second row.
A short cast-iron signpost on a round baseplate with three stacked colored directional blades.

new.name: ELF Header Canister
new.concept: ELF binary format (Executable and Linkable Format)
new.depicts: A cylindrical steel dispatch canister standing upright on a flat base, with a dark blue riveted collar band around the top and a hinged brass clasp.
new.focal: The riveted blue header collar and brass clasp.

new.name: PLT Jump-Jack
new.depicts: A small bakelite terminal block with two brass binding posts on the sides and a pivoted copper jumper bar arcing between them.
new.focal: The arched copper jumper bar bridging the two posts.

new.name: Relocation Splicer
new.depicts: A tabletop brass tape-splicing press on four stubby feet, with a dark tape strip threaded under a hinged yellow-handled crimping lever.

new.name: GOT Key-Rack
new.depicts: A tall wall-mounted dark iron key-rack with four horizontal rows of brass hooks, with one bright yellow brass key hanging on the second row.
new.focal: The single bright yellow key on the second hook.

new.name: RPATH Signpost
new.depicts: A short cast-iron signpost on a round baseplate with three stacked wooden directional blades painted in yellow, teal, and orange.
new.focal: The three stacked colored directional blades.

new.name: ABI Caliper
new.depicts: A small brass go/no-go pocket caliper lying on a dark rubber mat, its jaws set to a fixed yellow-marked gap.

rework.redesign: Redraw as a tabletop brass-and-bakelite trip-latch switch on a wooden plinth, with a coiled spring held back by a tiny yellow release pin.
